profile_text.body:
Celestica Inc. is a public company headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, and trades under the ticker CLS. On its own site, the company describes itself as a technology leader with expertise in design, engineering, and manufacturing, and says it works across high-growth markets. It states that it engineers, designs, and manufactures what it calls the backbone of AI and cloud technology, and that it enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud. The company also cites supply chain and platform solutions among its capabilities and describes a global network supporting its customers.

The site's account of the company's position is broad rather than product specific. Celestica presents AI and cloud infrastructure as the areas where its design, engineering, and manufacturing work is concentrated, and frames its role as helping customers gain a competitive advantage in those markets. No individual AI products, named executives, or partner organizations appear in the material available.

The record for the company includes a SEC Central Index Key, 0001030894, consistent with its status as a public filer. No litigation and no MCP servers are recorded for Celestica.
